इरिण n. (-णं)
 1. A desert, an inhospitable region.
 2. Salt or barren soil.
E. ऋ to go, इनन् Unādi affix, and the initial changed to इ.

. Saline and barren (soil.)
 E. ऋ to go,
and इरन् aff.

इरिमेद m. (-दः) A fetid mimosa: see विट्खदिर. E. See अरिमेद, अ being
changed to इ.

ईरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Sent, dispatched.
 2. Said, uttered.
 3.

. Made.
 E. ईर् to send, affix क्त.

ईरिताकूत n. (-तं) Declared purpose or intention.
 E. ईरित and आकूत
purpose.
